verdict.rationale: The pack has no explicit no-training policy or opt-out. It does show Qdrant can run entirely on user-controlled infrastructure: a self-hosted Docker image, the Apache-2.0 open-source engine, Private Cloud on any Kubernetes cluster, and Qdrant Edge with no network required. That keeps data away from the vendor, which indirectly prevents it from being used for training. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that customer data is not used to train AI models, documented training opt-out or data-use terms for Qdrant Cloud and its cloud-hosted embedding inference, and independent corroboration.
